audience: Arabic-speaking developers and students (Egypt first) scrolling Reels who lose hours to one failing test
promise: Claude Code reads your codebase, edits files and runs your tests from the terminal — shown as a staged example, no speed or accuracy claim
cta: جرّبه دلوقتي (no URL or contact supplied, none shown)
direction: One hero: the orange terminal cursor. Problem cursor → window → caret → bullet per step → edit marker → dot visiting three tests → circle wipe to cream → the tile. Ink #15130f / cream #f4efe6 / terracotta #d97757, Alexandria (display) + Space Mono (code). Springs by damping ratio (0.5–0.8), subframe motion blur, no glow/particles/gradients, no fade-up. 120 BPM original score, one hook returning every bar.

creative.viewer: an Arabic-speaking developer or student scrolling Reels
creative.problem: one failing test eats the whole day
creative.promise: a terminal agent that reads the code, edits the files and runs the tests (shown as a staged example)
creative.evidence: how Claude Code is publicly described (reads a codebase, edits files, runs commands/tests from the terminal); the code, test names and numbers on screen are an invented illustration and are labelled «مثال توضيحي»; no speed, accuracy or customer claim
creative.light: warm-black terminal world for the problem and the work; one cream world for the payoff
creative.camera: locked frames, a 2 % push per hold, decaying impact shakes on the beat, subframe motion blur on the cursor's hops
transitions: edit marker hops to the tests
circle wipe from the last test
creative.motion: one orange cursor on springs (ζ 0.5–0.8) does every job; slams and clip reveals, no fade-up, no glow, no particles, no gradients
creative.sound: A minor warning bell and thuds → typing ticks on the picture's own times → groove → C major drop on the tile; one hook (E G A G) returns every bar
creative.pacing: one idea per bar (2 s); headline held 1.0 s+, tagline 1.4 s, CTA 1.1 s, final hold to 10.0 s
creative.payoff: terminal-glyph tile, the name «Claude Code», three verbs, one action «جرّبه دلوقتي»
